01: Hex is the 4.2.0 toHexString() of each schema compiled against the production shared-utils DSL. The RC must produce the identical string, accept it in WalletSecretScalePreflight and re-encode Schema.read() byte-equal.
12: Each vector is a secret exactly as 4.2.0 (or 3.7.x for V2 chain accounts) stored it, built with the production 7508bc83 crypto and the 4.2.0 schema DSL, together with the durable public identity 4.2.0 recorded. The RC validator must accept every one (signing keeps working; safety invariant 4).

Sources: 4.2.0 AccountRepositoryDelegate.create (mnemonic), AccountRepositoryImpl.importNewAccount (raw seed), importFromJson (JSON), TonAccountRepository.create (TON, raw typed text stored), 3.7.4 importChainFromMnemonic/importChainFromSeed (V2 chain accounts).
